title: One line of artifacts/<product>/state/ledger.jsonl
description: Append-only record of entities runs created in the target. An entity is live once a 'created' event exists with no later 'deleted' event for the same type+ref. Destructive actions are allowed only on live entities created by the CURRENT run.

type.description: Entity kind, e.g. account, contact, booking.

ref.description: Stable identifier the target knows it by (record id, or unique name when no id exists).

cleanup.description: A created entity's cleanup recipe (D-075): the module catalogue's delete endpoint and the path parameter that takes `ref`. `ledger.mjs sweep` (human-only, between runs) uses it to delete what an ended run left.
